battle.name: 第三次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭
battle.brief: 第三次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭見於中文維基戰爭列表，開始於1507年，交戰方為莫斯科大公國與立陶宛大公國，戰區在東歐。歷史同期已列裝的真實裝備有英格蘭的蒙斯梅格攻城臼炮，正式識別名稱為Mons Meg，1449年已列裝。

kit.name: 蒙斯梅格攻城臼炮
kit.history: 蒙斯梅格屬於英格蘭王國的重型攻城臼炮，歸入王室攻城砲兵，部署於圍城陣地，主要任務是攻擊城牆及堡壘。

countries: 1507年的主要交戰者是瓦西里三世統治的莫斯科大公國，以及由波蘭國王瓦迪斯瓦夫二世同時擔任立陶宛大公的立陶宛大公國。自1386年起，波蘭王國與立陶宛大公國共享君主，但兩地仍保有各自的制度、領土與軍隊，因此不能把立陶宛軍自動等同於波蘭軍，也不能把莫斯科大公國直接當成後來俄羅斯帝國的全部。戰場集中於斯摩棱斯克領；該地名義上處於立陶宛勢力範圍內，斯摩棱斯克諸公家族與貴族卻又和莫斯科保有既存聯繫，使這場戰爭同時涉及一座要塞、西部邊防與地方權力。主要作戰軸線沿第聶伯河上游展開，奧爾沙、羅加喬夫方向的道路可通往斯摩棱斯克，亦使立陶宛方面的解援問題與莫斯科軍的後方安全相互牽動。這不是立沃尼亞戰線的延伸，而是第三次莫斯科－立陶宛戰爭中以斯摩棱斯克為核心的一段作戰。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents in 1507 were the Grand Duchy of Moscow under Vasili III and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania under Sigismund II of Poland in his capacity as grand duke. Since 1386, the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania had shared a monarch while retaining separate institutions, territories, and armies; a Lithuanian force therefore cannot automatically be described as a Polish army, nor can the Muscovite state simply be equated with the later Russian empire. Operations were concentrated in the Smolensk land. It was nominally within the Lithuanian sphere, although the Smolensk princely house and its nobles maintained existing connections with Moscow, making the campaign a struggle over a fortress, the western frontier, and local political authority at once. The main axis followed the upper Dnieper, while roads through Orsha and Rogachev connected with Smolensk and tied the Lithuanian relief problem to the security of the Muscovite rear. This was not an extension of the Livonian front, but the Smolensk-centered phase of the Third Moscow–Lithuanian War.
people: 莫斯科方面的最高政治決策者是莫斯科大公瓦西里三世，但現有史料沒有顯示他親自在斯摩棱斯克城下指揮攻圍。真正負責這次野戰行動的是丹尼爾·瓦西里耶維奇·什琴尼亞與米哈伊爾·安德烈耶維奇·布科夫；兩人都被記錄為1507年進入斯摩棱斯克領、包圍斯摩棱斯克的莫斯科主將。立陶宛方面的最高政治首腦則是兼具波蘭國王身分的瓦迪斯瓦夫二世，史料同樣沒有把他放在斯摩棱斯克圍城線上。康斯坦丁·奧斯特羅格斯基是這一時期立陶宛最重要的軍事貴族之一，常被列入相關戰爭的整體背景，但關於他是否親自指揮1507年解圍主力，各種敘述並不一致，不能把他寫成唯一且全程在場的城下指揮者。斯摩棱斯克守軍的實際指揮人及各地方部隊的完整名冊也較模糊。可確定的是，什琴尼亞與布科夫代表莫斯科的野戰統帥權，而立陶宛方面則由大公政府、地方貴族軍隊與斯摩棱斯克守軍共同承擔防禦和應援。
peopleEn: The highest political authority on the Muscovite side was Grand Prince Vasili III, although the surviving sources do not show him personally directing operations beneath the walls of Smolensk. The commanders actually associated with the field campaign were Daniil Vasilyevich Shchenya and Mikhail Andreyevich Bukov, both recorded as the Muscovite commanders who entered the Smolensk land and besieged the city in 1507. The supreme political leader on the Lithuanian side was Sigismund II of Poland in his capacity as grand duke, and the sources likewise do not place him on the Smolensk siege line. Konstanty Ostrogski was one of the most important Lithuanian military magnates of the period and is often included in the wider background to the war, but accounts do not consistently establish whether he personally commanded the principal relief force in 1507; he should not be presented as the sole commander certainly present throughout the operation. The identity of the actual Smolensk garrison commander and the complete list of local units are also uncertain. What can be established is that Shchenya and Bukov represented Muscovite field command, while defense and relief on the Lithuanian side depended collectively upon the grand-ducal government, magnate armies, and the Smolensk garrison.
kits: 1507年的裝備應按當時有文字或實物記錄的類型書寫，不能套用近代步槍線制或想像中的火器。莫斯科軍可見的武器包括普通弓與箭、俄文稱為самострел的手弩或早期掌式火器、十五世紀末已傳入歐亞軍隊的arquebus火繩手槍，以及槍矛、長矛、彎刀、錘斧和berdysh長柄斧。重裝騎士可能穿mail與小片金屬甲結合的yushman，或使用裝飾性較強的bakhterets；常規軍人則更多依賴鎖子甲、皮革防護、shishak或misyurka類頭盔與盾牌，不能假設全軍都有完整板甲。立陶宛與斯摩棱斯克部隊同樣使用弓、弩、arquebus、長矛、彎刀和大小盾牌，騎兵常配長矛，並使用鎖子甲或鎖子甲與板片組合的防具。攻城的核心是大型鐵砲，俄方史料常以pomор一詞稱呼這類重砲，另有中型野戰砲及tufyak一類的小型手砲；實際口徑、重量與射程因缺乏同期總冊而不應虛構。攻擊城牆還需梯子、遮蔽物、繩索和營帳，維持遠征則依靠載重車輛、馬匹、炊食、飼料、箭矢、弩箭、火藥以及與火炮相配的石製或金屬彈丸。
kitsEn: Equipment in 1507 should be described using types documented archaeologically or in contemporary sources, not by projecting nineteenth-century rifle drills or imagined firearms into the campaign. Muscovite weapons included ordinary bows and arrows, the Russian самострел, which could denote a hand crossbow or an early handheld firearm, the arquebus, a matchlock handgun already used by Eurasian armies in the late fifteenth century, as well as berdyshes, spears, sabers, maces, and axes. Heavily equipped riders might wear transitional mail-and-plate armor known as a yushman or the more decorative bakhterets, while ordinary troops relied more heavily on mail, leather protection, shields, and helmets of the shishak or misyurka families; it would be false to assume that the entire army possessed full plate armor. Lithuanian and Smolensk troops likewise used bows, crossbows, arquebuses, spears, sabers, and shields of several sizes. Their cavalry commonly carried lances and used mail or combined mail-and-plate protection. The principal siege weapon was the heavy iron cannon classed in Russian records as a pomor, accompanied by medium field guns and small cannon such as the tufyak. Their exact calibers, weights, and ranges should not be invented because no audited inventory survives. Wall attacks also required ladders, protective structures, ropes, and tents, while the field army depended on wagons, draught animals, provisions, fodder, bowstrings, bolts, gunpowder, and suitable stone or metal projectiles.
tactics: 從開拔到撤圍，莫斯科軍首先要處理速度不同的部隊：騎兵與先鋒可以先行，步兵較慢，大型火炮和載重車隊又更難通過道路與河谷。史料沒有留下各縱隊相隔多少里，但前進時必須避免騎兵、步兵和攻城砲脫節，也不能讓立陶宛騎兵各部逐個接近。進入斯摩棱斯克領後，主力意圖在解援部隊完成集結以前包圍城市，並以騎兵遮蔽遠方道路、以步兵與射手控制接近線。大砲部署在城牆有效射程之外，用於攻擊城牆、封鎖缺口及支援突擊；十五世紀末的射擊速度、瞄準與重新裝填條件，使火槍仍不能取代弓箭和近戰兵力。莫斯科軍曾嘗試以砲擊配合突擊迫使守軍投降，但斯摩棱斯克沒有出現足以導致全城失守的突破口，城防依靠牆體、火砲、投射武器與受控制的出擊抵禦。立陶宛方面的軍隊接近或威脅斯摩棱斯克後，莫斯科軍還必須防止城內守軍與外部兵力會合。留在城下意味著繼續承擔補給、彈藥與退路風險，撤圍則意味著放棄短期攻取城市的目標。實務上必須先準備撤出可用火炮與車輛，再由騎兵和步兵分層掩護，最後離開營地；史料雖不保存每一步的確切日期，這個順序最能解釋為何主軍最終沒有繼續包圍。
tacticsEn: From the opening march to the withdrawal, the Muscovite army first had to reconcile formations that moved at different speeds. Cavalry and an advance detachment could move rapidly, infantry traveled more slowly, and heavy cannon and baggage wagons had greater difficulty passing roads and river valleys. The sources do not state the precise distance between columns, but the advance had to prevent cavalry, infantry, and siege guns from becoming separated and exposed to Lithuanian riders operating in smaller formations. After entering the Smolensk land, the main force sought to invest the city before relief troops could concentrate, screen distant roads with cavalry, and control the approaches with infantry and missile troops. Cannon were placed beyond effective wall range to batter fortifications, seal openings, and support attacks. The firing speed, aiming, and reloading conditions of late-fifteenth-century firearms meant that handguns could not replace bows, crossbows, and close combat. Bombardment was followed by attempts to force surrender, but no breach developed that exposed the entire city to capture. The defense relied on its walls, artillery, missile troops, and controlled sorties. As Lithuanian forces approached or threatened to join the garrison, the besiegers also risked confinement between the city and an opposing field army. Remaining before Smolensk meant continuing to carry provisions, ammunition, and retreat risks, while raising the siege meant abandoning the immediate objective of taking the city. In practice, usable cannon and wagons had to be prepared for removal, followed by a withdrawal covered in layers by cavalry and infantry. Although no document preserves the exact dates of each movement, this sequence best explains why the main army eventually abandoned the siege.
data: 史家通常把第三次莫斯科－立陶宛戰爭列為1506年至1510年；題名中的1507年宜理解為以斯摩棱斯克作戰為中心的戰役年度，而不是一場只有一日的會戰。現有敘述能支持的主要時間節點是：戰爭在1506年再度延續；1507年暖季，莫斯科主力進入斯摩棱斯克領；夏末的攻城通常被概略放在8月前後；許多概述將包圍延續寫作約六週，其後主力撤出。史料不足以可靠指定首輪砲擊、突擊或開始撤退的確切日期。莫斯科主力、立陶宛解援部隊與斯摩棱斯克守軍的人數，也沒有能彼此核對的同期徵發名冊；後世著作常以概括性的大數字代替原始名冊。因此本文只確定包圍曾發生、持續約數週、攻城未竟及軍隊最後撤退，不虛構任何一方兵力，也不列出不可靠的俘虜或精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: Historians generally date the Third Moscow–Lithuanian War from 1506 to 1510. The designation 1507 should therefore be understood as the campaign year centered on operations at Smolensk, not as the date of a single-day battle. The surviving narrative supports the following sequence: hostilities resumed in 1506; during the warm season of 1507 the main Muscovite force entered the Smolensk land; the siege is generally placed in late summer, often around August; and many summaries describe the investment as lasting approximately six weeks before the army withdrew. The evidence does not securely identify the exact day of the first bombardment, assault, or beginning of retreat. No contemporary muster rolls reconcile the numbers of the Muscovite main army, Lithuanian relief troops, and Smolensk garrison, and later accounts frequently substitute generalized large figures for original records. This account consequently establishes only that the siege occurred, lasted for an approximate period, failed to capture the city, and ended in withdrawal. It does not invent a precise army strength, prisoner count, or casualty total for either side.
cause: 1507年的斯摩棱斯克攻勢不是一個孤立事件突然造成的，而是第三次戰爭長期矛盾在1507年的集中表現。瓦西里三世於1505年即位後，莫斯科最高層存在貴族與王公派系競逐，接連的內部衝突使邊境軍事成就具有鞏固政權的實際意義。斯摩棱斯克位於莫斯科與立陶宛之間的西部交通地帶，控制第聶伯河上游道路和地方諸公家族；對莫斯科而言，將其牢固置於立陶宛手中會留下可供敵方集結與施壓的前進基地，對立陶宛而言，則不能輕易放棄這個屏障。莫斯科的宮殿系與斯摩棱斯克諸公之間長期存在婚姻、效忠及政治联系，使效忠問題從未完全固定於單一陣營。1505年後的外交安排未能穩定這些關係，戰事於1506年重新展開，到了1507年，莫斯科便把奪取或孤立斯摩棱斯克作為主要野戰目標。立陶宛與波蘭共享君主後具有較大的軍事調度範圍，但具體的波蘭部隊是否參加斯摩棱斯克圍城仍須與本地立陶宛部隊區分。
causeEn: The Smolensk offensive of 1507 was not the product of one isolated incident, but the concentrated expression of longer-term causes behind the Third Moscow–Lithuanian War. After Vasili III took the throne in 1505, competition among magnate and princely factions at the Muscovite court made frontier success relevant to the consolidation of the new government. Smolensk lay among the western communications of Moscow and Lithuania and controlled routes along the upper Dnieper together with its local princely house. For Moscow, leaving it securely in Lithuanian hands created a forward position from which an opponent could concentrate and apply pressure; for Lithuania, it was equally important not to surrender that barrier. Dynastic, marriage, service, and political ties between the Muscovite court and the Smolensk princely house also meant that local loyalties had never become permanently fixed on one side. Diplomatic arrangements established after 1505 did not stabilize these relationships. Hostilities resumed in 1506, and by 1507 Moscow had made the isolation or seizure of Smolensk its principal field objective. The personal union with Poland gave Lithuania a broader resource base, but any specifically Polish contingent at the siege must still be distinguished from locally raised Lithuanian units.
impact: 這次戰役的直接影響首先表現在斯摩棱斯克沒有失守，莫斯科原定的近程戰略成果未能實現。大砲可以封鎖城牆周邊、支援進攻並迫使守軍依賴城防，卻不能單憑射擊迅速消除城牆、射擊孔、補給線和城內兵力之間的整體抵抗。莫斯科軍還必須在守軍可能出擊、解援可能會合的情況下維持包圍，車隊、火藥、飼料與彈藥使停留時間成為戰術限制。立陶宛方面的實際影響則是保住通往斯摩棱斯克的西部防線，使莫斯科無法藉此次進取得到一個新的據點，也沒有改變1507年 campaign結束時的實際邊界。這並不表示整場戰爭已取得終局性結果，因為莫斯科與立陶宛在1508年至1510年仍繼續作战，後來的奧爾沙行動與1510年的格連卡夫列戰役不能倒算成1507年包圍的必然成果。較準確的評價是，1507年的斯摩棱斯克階段屬於立陶宛方面的防禦成功，而非莫斯科－立陶宛戰爭的最終勝負。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the campaign was that Smolensk did not fall and Moscow failed to achieve its immediate operational objective. Artillery could封锁 the approaches to the walls, support attacks, and compel the defenders to remain within their fortifications, but cannon fire alone could not rapidly eliminate the combined resistance of walls, firing positions, supply arrangements, and the garrison. The besiegers also had to maintain their investment while the garrison might sortie and relief forces might approach. Wagons, gunpowder, fodder, and ammunition made the duration of the siege a tactical liability. Lithuania preserved the western approach to Smolensk, Moscow gained no new stronghold, and the practical frontier was unchanged when the 1507 campaign ended. This did not settle the wider war: Moscow and Lithuania continued fighting in 1508–1510, and neither the later operations around Orsha nor the Battle of Grinkavlė in 1510 should be projected backward as a result already achieved at Smolensk. The most accurate assessment is that the Smolensk phase of 1507 was a successful Lithuanian defense, not the final decision in the Third Moscow–Lithuanian War.
result: 包圍最後以莫斯科軍撤營告終。斯摩棱斯克沒有被攻破，守軍及其統治機構仍留在城中，主力遂把能移動的火炮、車輛與隨軍物資帶離城下，軍隊返回莫斯科控制區；可用裝備是否全部運回以及有多少重砲因損壞留下，史料均未提供可靠清單。這一結果使1507年的斯摩棱斯克作戰在戰術層面上以立陶宛守方成功阻止攻取告終，在莫斯科方面則等於未能實現當年包圍斯摩棱斯克的目標。戰爭本身沒有因此立即結束，仍延續到1510年；因此「1507年戰役結束」只能指莫斯科對斯摩棱斯克的野戰部署解散，不能指第三次莫斯科－立陶宛戰爭已取得永久和平或最終政治 solution。
resultEn: The siege ended when the Muscovite army finally broke camp. Smolensk was not breached, its garrison and governing structures remained in the city, and the withdrawing force took away whatever cannon, wagons, and baggage could be moved before returning toward territory controlled by Moscow. The sources do not provide a reliable inventory showing how much equipment reached Moscow safely or how many heavy guns were damaged or abandoned. The Smolensk operation therefore ended with Lithuania having prevented the city from being taken and Moscow having failed to fulfill that year’s immediate objective. The wider war did not end at that moment and continued until 1510. The end of the 1507 campaign consequently means only that the Muscovite investment of Smolensk was dissolved; it does not mean that the Third Moscow–Lithuanian War had produced a permanent peace or a final political settlement.
